name: One Pan Chicken and Potatoes for Effortless Cooking Fun
description: Enjoy a hassle-free meal with One Pan Chicken and Potatoes, featuring juicy chicken thighs and crispy potatoes, all seasoned to perfection.
ingredients: 4 pieces chicken thighs and drumsticks (juicy and flavorful cuts)
4 cups potatoes (russet or Yukon gold, cut into even pieces)
2 tablespoons olive oil (can be swapped with canola oil)
1 tablespoon dried oregano (fresh oregano can be substituted)
2 tablespoons lemon juice (adjust to fit your taste)
instructions: Whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, tomato paste, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, oregano, black pepper, and paprika in a bowl.
Prepare your chicken and potatoes. Pat the chicken dry and cut the potatoes into uniform pieces.
Arrange the chicken and potatoes on a large baking sheet, ensuring they're spread out without overcrowding.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and potatoes, making sure everything is well-coated.
Bake uncovered for about 40 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are tender.
Rest the dish for 5 minutes, then garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
